decision: Repeat no scientific observation from V17. Replace its invalid blanket package-metadata gate with targeted runtime compatibility checks, then amortize placement, image pull, checkpoint transfer, and model load across one fail-closed semantic, paired-quality, fixed-SLO, economics, and conditional-trace sequence.

causal_hypothesis.primary: The checkpoint-author-documented vLLM 0.15 plus checkpoint-era Transformers combination is runtime-compatible despite its expected metadata conflict. Removing vLLM's CUDA forward-compat linker entries and validating the actual GLM loader, AutoConfig, vLLM import, and CUDA tensor will permit stock vLLM to load the AWQ checkpoint on Nebius L40S.
causal_hypothesis.stock_control: V13 complete BF16 on Nebius H100: c1 87.1156 output tok/s, c8 305.0449 output tok/s, fixed SLO pass, compact quality 0.333 and NLL 7.6455 with absolute gate failure, derived full-VM-plus-disk $3.52799/M output tokens.
causal_hypothesis.runtime_disambiguation_control: V15 custom SGLang AWQ produced nondeterministic gibberish. V16 failed in CUDA compatibility before load. V17 proved the linker cleanup and dependency closure but stopped on an invalid package-metadata check before transfer.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: Targeted preflight passes. Correct stock-vLLM semantics would isolate V15's custom SGLang loader as faulty; invalid stock-vLLM semantics would reject this public checkpoint lineage. Conditional on paired quality and fixed SLO, L40S AWQ should reduce cost relative to BF16 H100.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: Preflight failure stops before transfer; invalid semantics stops quality/performance; paired quality failure rejects quality-adjusted economics; c8 below 67.565 tok/s rejects even a BF16-H100 cost win.

changed_from_v17.dependency_install: Install the pinned Transformers source with its full dependency closure, as Repair 01 did.
changed_from_v17.validation: Remove blanket pip check. Require exact Transformers 5.3.0.dev0, glm4_moe_lite AutoConfig recognition, vLLM import, vLLM GLM loader-module import, host-driver libcuda resolution, L40S identity, and a real CUDA tensor.
changed_from_v17.failure_policy: Primary and recovery drivers both open a bounded 600-second decision window after any untyped failure when no typed scientific result exists.
changed_from_v17.repeat_classification: Material validator and recovery-policy corrections; no V17 model bytes or scientific arm executed, so this is not an unchanged scientific retry.

stock_runtime.derived_container_recipe: exact base digest plus full dependency installation from the pinned Transformers source archive; derived image ID measured before use
stock_runtime.cuda_compatibility: delete 00-cuda-compat.conf and cuda-compat.conf then ldconfig before every Python import

conditional_sequence: pull exact base image and build derived image
targeted GLM/vLLM/Transformers/CUDA preflight before checkpoint transfer
verified 20.17GB checkpoint transfer and remote checksum
two exact deterministic semantic JSON requests
paired development quality capture against V13 responses including runtime teacher-forced prompt-logprob NLL
one warmup plus c1 four-request and c8 sixteen-request exact 8192-input/1024-output profiles
bounded post-timing PyTorch trace only if paired quality passes and L40S cost beats complete-BF16 H100

quality_gate.semantic: two normalized messages identical and both contents parse after optional fence removal exactly as {alpha:17,beta:smoke}
quality_gate.absolute_quality: V13 absolute compact-screen failure is carried forward; no quality-adjusted business claim is possible
quality_gate.claim_limit: paired representation diagnostic only; not general model quality

service_contract.cache_fairness: --no-enable-prefix-caching and zero prefix-cache query/hit counter deltas required
service_contract.preemption: provider stop is infrastructure failure only

economics.claim_rule: No cost improvement claim without exact fixed geometry, fixed SLO pass, and paired quality pass; no Fireworks/Baseten claim without matched provider evidence.

budget.limitations: public IPv4 and egress excluded; invoice pending

telemetry: one-second GPU utilization, VRAM, power, temperature, and clocks
TTFT, TPOT, end-to-end latency, output throughput, exact token geometry, queueing, and failures

total allocation exposure and derived cost

artifact_contract.cleanup: retrieve and hash before deletion; verify instance GET not-found and zero named instances/disks

stop_rules.delivery: Any source/remote hash, shard-count, or byte mismatch stops before load.
stop_rules.semantics: Any HTTP failure, nondeterminism, non-JSON, or wrong object stops quality/performance and rejects the public checkpoint lineage on this stock runtime/device geometry.
stop_rules.quality: Paired regression or NLL failure rejects quality-adjusted economics and suppresses tracing; fixed performance may still run diagnostically because setup is sunk.
stop_rules.performance: Exact-geometry, nonzero prefix-cache counters, or SLO failure rejects economics; below 67.565 c8 tok/s rejects a cost win over complete BF16 H100.
stop_rules.repair_in_place: On every untyped infrastructure or harness failure, keep the allocation alive for up to 600 seconds while deciding whether a materially changed preregistered repair can start immediately. Tear down a completed scientific result, safety/spend stop, or when the next useful test requires more than ten minutes.
stop_rules.repeat: Do not repeat any failed placement, runtime, or validator unchanged.
stop_rules.cleanup: Always retrieve and hash available evidence, delete instance/disk, and verify empty inventories.
